taxonomy.incorrect_routing: final answer wrong; the routed model was wrong but a stronger model was right, and escalation did not recover
taxonomy.model_capability_failure: no model in the pool answered correctly (reasoning/knowledge limit)
taxonomy.extraction_failure: no answer could be parsed from the final response
taxonomy.high_confidence_wrong: initial answer wrong, its confidence was above the acceptance threshold, and the verifier did not reject it
taxonomy.low_confidence_correct: initial answer correct but flagged as low-confidence (unnecessary escalation)
taxonomy.verifier_false_pass: a verifier accepted a wrong final answer
taxonomy.verifier_false_fail: a verifier rejected a correct initial answer
taxonomy.escalation_failure: escalated, still wrong, although some model in the pool was correct
taxonomy.escalation_harm: initial answer correct, final answer wrong after escalation
taxonomy.language_related_failure: wrong in a non-English language while the English parallel item was answered correctly by the same system and seed
taxonomy.retrieval_failure: retrieval stage ran but no retrieved passage contained the gold answer
taxonomy.unsupported_answer: answer produced after retrieval failed (answer without evidence)
